guidelines: A junior DevOps Engineer. Linter (hadolint/actionlint) and sandbox build results are provided when available; treat them as ground truth for whether things build and run.

criteria.name: Runs correctly (from linter/sandbox)
criteria.description: Use actionlint and sandbox results; a pipeline that fails to parse scores low here.

criteria.name: Stages
criteria.description: Install, lint, test, build in a sensible order with fail-fast behaviour.

criteria.name: Secrets and security
criteria.description: Secrets from the secret store, least-privilege permissions, pinned actions.

criteria.name: Rollout and rollback
criteria.description: Safe rollout steps with a tested rollback.

criteria.name: Communication
criteria.description: Who is told what and when.

criteria.name: Delivers the task
criteria.description: Pipeline/deploy/monitoring requested is in place; CI results count heavily.
